A.depoimento: I trained two spearmen and launched two armies: one to Santarem, one to Evora, aiming to bring both neutral villages under my rule.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce Santarem and Evora with fresh troops, continue building spearmen, and send armies toward Coimbra and Badajoz to expand control. Keep wood reserves for further builds.

A.depoimento: Built two spearmen in Lisboa and reinforced Santarem. Sent forces toward Coimbra, Badajoz, and Faro to prepare for next-turn assaults. Holding strong as we expand westward.
A.plano: Next turn, attack Coimbra, Badajoz, Faro with the marching armies. Continue building spearmen in Lisboa. Keep wood reserves for further builds. Ensure garrisons stay above 0.

A.depoimento: I ordered spearmen built in Lisboa, Santarem, and Evora to bolster our defenses. I dispatched Santarem's full garrison to seize Salamanca and Evora's two knights to take Porto, aiming to secure key footholds on the road to Barcelona. My remaining troops hold the line at home, ready to reinforce the newly won villages once they arrive.

Expect heavy losses on attacking forces; reinforce captured villages with incoming builds and home garrisons. Do not divert troops from Coimbra, Badajoz, Faro this turn to preserve defenses.

B.depoimento:

Sent all available troops from Barcelona to bolster Tarragona.
Launched attacks from Girona to seize Castellon and Huesca.

Prepare to attack Zaragoza using archers from Tarragona.
Keep defensive core at Barcelona with newly built knights.

A.depoimento: This turn I marched spearmen from Lisboa, Santarem and Evora to take Toledo. The neutral fortress fell after a fierce clash, adding a new village to my realm. Simultaneously I ordered a massive spearmen build across my holdings to prepare for the next push.
A.plano: Turn 5: Toledo captured. Next turn, fresh spearmen will be ready; focus on assembling force at Salamanca for a push on Madrid. Continue building spearmen in all villages except Salamanca until it gains resources. Do not divert troops to Vigo or Sevilha yet.

B.depoimento: This turn I reinforced the attack on Teruel with two spearmen from Tarragona and one knight from Castellon. I built additional spearmen in all villages to replenish forces and maintain defenses. No enemy movements were seen.
B.plano: Next turn, secure Teruel with a garrison, then prepare to attack Valencia using archers from Tarragona. Build more knights in Barcelona for a future Zaragoza assault. Keep all defenses strong.

A.depoimento:

- I directed each of my villages to train four spearmen, stockpiling infantry for the coming push.

- Build spearmen in all villages to replenish forces.
- Hold position; do not commit knights or archers yet due to iron shortage.
- Prepare to follow up with Vigo and Sevilha after Toledo falls.

We built spearmen in all villages and added archers in Coimbra, Faro, Salamanca to prepare for future assaults on Vigo and Sevilha. Next turn we will gather archers to attack Vigo and Sevilha, while reinforcing captured towns and continuing to build spearmen.

Send knights from Lisboa, Santarem, and Evora to seize Sevilha.
Maintain marching spears to Vigo and archers to Cordoba.
Do not engage Zaragoza until we have stronger forces.

A.depoimento: We raised new spearmen and knights across our realms and dispatched a strong detachment toward Sevilha. Our marching knight from Lisboa will join them next turn to seize the neutral village. All other holdings stand firm, ready for the upcoming push toward Toledo and Madrid.

Send 8 spears+1 knight from Badajoz and 4 spears from Lisboa to Sevilha for arrival next turn.

Do not attack Burgos or Toledo until we have stronger forces.

B.depoimento: I ordered archers to be built in every village and sent three knights from Madrid to take the neutral village of Burgos, expanding our realm.

Hold Salamanca and Porto as secondary fronts.
Do not divert troops from the Toledo-Burgos axis until both cities are secured.

Build archers in Badajoz and Vigo; build knights in Lisboa.
Send knight from Toledo to take Cordoba and spearman to take Teruel.
Hold Toledo with remaining troops and reinforce captured villages next turn.
Do not attack Burgos this turn due to incoming enemy army.

Defend Toledo by sending all available reinforcements; keep minimal garrisons elsewhere.
Build archers in Badajoz and Vigo, build knights in Lisboa.
Do not launch any offensives this turn; focus on consolidation and preparation for next turn's assault on Madrid.

I shifted knights from Tarragona to Zaragoza to bolster defenses. I also ordered new archers in Valencia and Teruel and a knight in Burgos to ready for future assaults.

Build archers at Badajoz and Vigo, knights at Lisboa, spears at Santarem, Evora, Cordoba, Sevilha, Faro. Send reinforcements: Badajoz->Toledo (4 archer), Porto->Vigo (4 spear), Santarem->Salamanca (4 spear). Do not split the main Toledo army.

B.plano: Next turn: continue building archers in Valencia and Teruel, knights in Burgos. After destroying the enemy army near Salamanca, reinforce Madrid and prepare to capture Salamanca. Then build forces to take Murcia and Vigo.
